sessions.title: Поляна POLUS

workflows.name: polus-next-1
workflows.desc: Prepare the approved waves while polus-feel-2 finishes: implementation maps for hands+HUD (65), ledger+craft+inventory (66), free build phase 1 (64); standalone new-file code now (mesh IO + volume, MatterLedger) with headless tests; a cross-wave critic

workflows.name: polus-tex-process
workflows.desc: Process the 28 Codex textures: seam check, make_pbr (seamless albedo + height, normal, roughness), 3x3 tile previews, acceptance table; no game files touched

workflows.name: polus-design-build
workflows.desc: Design pass for free 3D building by the volume law: history of inventory/craft/building decisions, architecture for a free editor + templates + OBJ/GLB import with exact mesh volume, then a critic

workflows.name: polus-hydro-argon
workflows.desc: Verify the merged Astra + Argon tools/terrain/hydrology.py: unit tests, the 6-region river suite (thalweg), speed, outputs only into a scratch folder

workflows.name: polus-design-1
workflows.desc: Design pass for Maxim 04.11 F1-F7: screen inventory + stones of expertise + world buttons + concept prompts; layered ground spec; matter law, tool wear, 2-material craft; HD looks plan; then a cross-check critic

workflows.name: polus-feel-2
workflows.desc: Fix Maxim 04.11 batch (13 items: auto swing, stump, trajectory holes, stone/glass/ice physics, spikes, shovel load, water sounds, mesh holes, ground squares) + 13 feel-1 leftovers with a red-then-green test per bug; integrate, adversarial tests, polish (web-final11)

workflows.name: polus-feel-1
workflows.desc: Fix Maxim 02.11 playtest batch (18 items: hands/strike, wood, stone, range, ground) with a red-then-green test per bug; integrate, adversarial tests, polish (web-final10)

workflows.name: polus-matter-w2
workflows.desc: Variant E wave 2: brittle kinds + glass shatter + thin slabs break through, tool wear + sharpening, water + bucket, drop/throw impacts, granular kinds, range rows II-IV; integrate, polish (web-final9)

workflows.name: polus-matter-w1
workflows.desc: Variant E wave 1: material cards + one blow law + gate + one hint (bit-identical), then the material test range (wood, stone, soil); integrate, polish

workflows.name: polus-backlog-7
workflows.desc: Maxim's 13 edits: aim modes + wheel, look-switch lag, stones (hand tint, no interpenetration, pick flag, tiny rule), wood pieces, Tab/I + F1, ground look + regrowth + time skip; integrate, polish

workflows.name: polus-matter-plan
workflows.desc: Plan variant E (one material law, per-class canvases, tags) in waves + a material test range near spawn; checked against code

workflows.name: polus-matter-design
workflows.desc: Real physics of how materials break + how games do it + material catalogue -> 4-5 simple one-formula variants for POLUS, checked

workflows.name: polus-physics-explain
workflows.desc: Read the POLUS code and explain how wood, stone and soil are computed inside; verify every claim

workflows.name: polus-fix-6
workflows.desc: Maxim playtest bugs: wood islands split into bodies, no floating wood; tree thinning, coherent sway, depth colour; fixed reach, idle side pose, aim freezes; ground friction, no spinning; integrate, verify, fix

workflows.name: polus-physics-video
workflows.desc: Explainer video on POLUS physics (swing energy, wood, stone, soil, tools): real numbers from the game code, script, HTML scene, viewer-seat review

workflows.name: polus-fx-donors
workflows.desc: Study Ultra-Water, ultra-elements and pixelfx (code + live demos) and decide what POLUS (Godot 4.7, WebGL2, low-poly 3D) can take and how

workflows.name: polus-polish-5
workflows.desc: Fence post / timber cut-through, log = trunk cut, felled crown + birch + branch item looks, branch sever perf, rock hit browser perf; verify; fix

workflows.name: polus-materials-4
workflows.desc: One material model + same hit physics/debug for trees, logs, built members, branches, rocks, built stones; tool hard/loose settings; <10 kg pieces are bag items with a 3D detail panel; branches on trees; integrate, verify, fix

workflows.name: polus-polish-3
workflows.desc: Rock hit perf (incremental refresh), granite tint, wood chip slivers, irregular litter, mouse relock after P/Tab, spectator lock, then full regress + browser verify

workflows.name: polus-physics-2
workflows.desc: Opera mouse lock, crouch/sprint, SS14 hands + Minecraft inventory UI, physical axe arc + contact + sections, stumps/litter/uproot/soil on tools, real stone fracture, breakable buildings, integration

workflows.name: polus-hands-1
workflows.desc: Two hands like SS14 (one/two-hand grip), shovel sizes, free tree aim with blade-width notches and wood grain, stone bedding, test range spawner, integration, review

workflows.name: polus-tools-1
workflows.desc: Wood/stone in m3 only, stone chunks, carrying logs/stones, universal tools (shape x material) with physique and real impact physics, integration, review

workflows.name: polus-build-1
workflows.desc: Rocks near the spawn, building from felled logs by volume (constructor), shovel dump marker + wheelbarrow, integration, review

workflows.name: polus-tools-1
workflows.desc: Hotbar with all tools + berries/hunger, pickaxe dents in rocks, shovel digging with exact soil conservation, integration, review

workflows.name: polus-forest-2
workflows.desc: More species + giant sequoias + bushes, chips = exact cut volume, trunk-only fall physics, then perf/look polish and review

workflows.name: polus-big-map-2
workflows.desc: Big valley map (bake + world, continued), new simple axes, more chips and music, then review + verify

workflows.name: polus-sandbox-step1
workflows.desc: POLUS: research physical crafting, chopping (with spike), sandbox loop -> rewrite GDD v4 -> plan step 1 -> review -> fix

workflows.name: polus-gdd-v4-m1
workflows.desc: POLUS v4: research (code, match map, web build, camera/anim, epochs+mystic) -> GDD v4 -> M1 plan -> review -> fix
